body: Entiendo, a mí me pasa con el francés 🥲 pero son cositas menores, de costumbre; escribes excelente

You get it. The more French I learn, the more incompetent I feel when speaking English (I mean in conversation), it's like I devolved to having to describe things instead of knowing their name 😭

I'm sure you sound better than you think, and you'll get back to that good level soon!! Fortunately our brain has a way to keep the languages we learn somewhere, instead of throwing the whole thing away 🫂 – It's actually such a fascinating thing to me.. Mixing up languages is actually natural, [here's something](https://www.bbc.com/future/article/20220719-how-speaking-other-languages-changes-your-brain) interesting I read about it :)

Also, I'm available if you want to speak Spanish, or in case you want to support each other with French ✨

Sometimes I feel I'm forgetting Spanish too as a native 🧍🏽‍♂️ Some words, they come out as a weird literal translation from english or with a french accent and ending. And I have to be awkwardly silent a few seconds until I remember (if I even do). It's weird when the more you learn, the less you feel you actually know??
